[[Than Quảng Ninh F.C.|Quảng Ninh]]|position=top}} }} ===Match-fixing scandal=== [[Vissai Ninh Bình F.C.|Ninh Bình]] wrote to the Vietnam Football Federation (VFF) and to the Vietnam Professional Football Joint Stock Company to be allowed to stop their participation in the league and also the AFC Cup due to 13 players being involved in match fixing. They had played 8 league matches and were third from bottom at the time.{{cite web |url=http://www.aseanfootball.org/v2/?p=16076 |title=AFC to Monitor Vietnam Match-Fixing Issue |work=aseanfootball.org |date=April 12, 2014 |access-date=April 12, 2014 |archive-date=April 13, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140413130221/http://www.aseanfootball.org/v2/?p=16076 |url-status=dead }} Following their withdrawal from the league, all their results were declared null and void.{{cite web |url=http://www.aseanfootball.org/v2/?p=16131 |title=Ninh Binh Quit V-League but Not AFC Cup |work=aseanfootball.org |date=April 18, 2014 |access-date=April 18, 2014 |archive-date=April 19, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140419013259/http://www.aseanfootball.org/v2/?p=16131 |url-status=dead }} ===Rule Changes=== Due to the match fixing scandal and withdrawal of [[Vissai Ninh Bình F.C.|Ninh Bình]], it was decided that the bottom-placed team at the end of the season will take part in a play-off match against the third-placed team in the First Division for the right to play in the V-League next season.{{cite web |url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/100156/organisers-adjust-v-league-after-ninh-binh-withdrawal.html |title=Organisers adjust V-League after Ninh Binh withdrawal |work=english.vietnamnet.vn |date=April 17, 2014 |access-date=April 17, 2014 |archive-date=December 21, 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141221174245/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/100156/organisers-adjust-v-league-after-ninh-binh-withdrawal.html |url-status=dead }} ===Stadium and locations=== {| width="90%" class="wikitable sortable" |- !Club !Based !Home stadium !Capacity !First season
